title: Tracker training schema
description: A strength-training schema. Use EITHER `exercises` (one training day) OR `days` (several days, e.g. Push/Pull/Legs), never both (enforced by the app validator, as are repsMax >= reps and consecutive superset groups). Mirrors the SchemaJson type in src/features/training/lib/schemaJson.ts; keep both in sync.

exercises.description: Single-day schema: ordered list of exercises. Omit when using `days`.

days.description: Multi-day schema: one entry per training day. Day names must be unique. Omit when using `exercises`.

rotation.description: Optional training rhythm for multi-day schemas, as day names from `days` (a day may repeat), e.g. ["Push", "Pull", "Push", "Legs"]. Without it days rotate in order.

exercise.description: Exercise name. Matched case-insensitively against the user's exercise library; prefer existing names. Unknown names are created as new exercises.

reps.description: Target reps per set; the lower bound when `repsMax` is set.

repsMax.description: Upper bound of a rep range (must be >= `reps`). E.g. reps 8 + repsMax 12 = 8-12 reps.

restSeconds.description: Rest between sets in seconds (15-600). Omit to use the app defaults.

supersetGroup.description: Label shared by two or more CONSECUTIVE exercises that are trained as a superset (alternating sets), e.g. "A". Exercises with the same label must be adjacent.

reason.description: Short rationale for this prescription or change. Informational only; not stored.

name.description: Day name, unique within the schema (e.g. "Push").

reason.description: Short rationale for this day. Informational only; not stored.
